summary: First-run testing of AdsCopilot. All 10 backend pytest cases pass (auth, campaigns CRUD, analytics, ai/adcopy, ai/keywords, chat SSE + history). Frontend end-to-end flow verified: register/login, dashboard metrics, 5-step Create Campaign wizard, campaign detail, list with toggle+delete, Ad Copy Studio (Claude generation), Keyword Lab, Analytics, Copilot streaming, toggle-copilot, logout+re-login. One real UI overlay bug: Copilot send button is intercepted by the 'Made with Emergent' floating badge; submission still works via Enter key.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' floating badge (fixed at bottom-right of the viewport) covers the copilot send button so Playwright/user cannot click it. Enter-to-submit works, so streaming and persistence are functional, but the visible send button is not clickable. Reproduces at 1920x1080 on the /campaigns route (and any route where the badge is present).

issues: Recharts prints repeated console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Occurs on first mount before ResponsiveContainer measures parent. Cosmetic (charts render correctly), but noisy in console.

action_items: Raise the CopilotPanel input row above the Emergent badge — e.g. add bottom padding/margin to the panel input container (mb-12 / pb-14) or reposition the panel form so the send button clears the fixed badge in bottom-right at 1920x1080.
Optional: fix Recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents explicit min-height or setting aspect ratios.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 471-line module — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting (auth, campaigns, ai, chat) as it grows past ~700 lines.

_llm_json falls back to {"_raw": text} on JSON parse failure. Frontend AdCopyStudio/KeywordLab should defensively handle this shape (currently relies on model returning valid JSON — it did in all tests, but a bad LLM response would break the UI silently).
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with '*' so this is fine here, but flag it for prod hardening.

chat_stream persists the assistant message only inside event_gen after StreamDone; if the client disconnects mid-stream the partial assistant reply is lost (no partial-persistence). Acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test run created a couple of TEST_ and 'UI Test *' campaigns on the demo user via backend + UI. Backend CRUD test cleans up its own campaign; UI-created 'UI Test' campaign remains on the demo account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. All API contracts verified. Only remaining known UI issue is the Copilot send button being overlapped by the Emergent badge (bottom-right); after fix, re-verify by clicking [data-testid=copilot-send-btn] and confirming streaming into [data-testid=copilot-messages].
